extName.message: SureTab – Save Tabs, Never Lose Them

extDesc.message: Save all tabs in one click and never lose them. Automatic bookmark backup, trash, snapshots. Imports from OneTab & Toby.

cmdSaveWindow.message: Save all tabs in this window

ctxSaveWindow.message: Save all tabs in this window

saveWindow.message: Save all tabs in this window

recoverTitle.message: We found a backup of your tabs

recoverBody.message: Your list is empty, but the bookmark backup has $ARG1$ in $ARG2$. Restore them?

emptyBody.message: Click the SureTab icon and choose “Save all tabs in this window”. Coming from OneTab or Toby? Use Import.

importHelp.message: Paste your OneTab export (“Export URLs”), a Toby JSON export, a SureTab backup, or a plain list of links. Nothing is replaced: imported tabs are added.

importNone.message: No links found. Check the format and try again.

exportHelp.message: Download a full backup file, or copy everything as text in OneTab's format.

trashHelp.message: Deleted groups and links stay here for 30 days.

confirmEmptyTrash.message: Delete everything in the trash forever?

optRestoreUnloaded.message: Restore tabs without loading them (saves memory)

optRemoveOnRestore.message: Remove tabs from the list when you open them

bookmarkBackupHelp.message: SureTab keeps a copy of all your groups in the “SureTab backup” bookmarks folder. It survives browser updates and syncs with your Google account.

snapshotsHelp.message: SureTab saves a snapshot of your list at most once an hour (last 5). Use one to go back in time.

confirmRestoreSnapshot.message: Replace your current list with this snapshot? (Your current list is kept as a new snapshot.)

reviewBody.message: A short review helps other people find it. It takes 30 seconds.

proPitch.message: Your tabs stay safe even if something happens to your computer.

perkDrive.message: Automatic backup to your own Google Drive

perkVersions.message: A daily copy, kept for 30 days

perkMove.message: Move your tabs to another computer

perkOnce.message: One payment, yours forever. No subscription.

licenseInvalid.message: That key isn't valid. Check that you copied it completely.

licenseLimit.message: This key is already active on 3 computers. Deactivate it on one of them first.

licenseWrong.message: That key belongs to a different product.

licenseNetwork.message: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.

permDenied.message: SureTab needs that permission to continue.

proActive.message: ✓ SureTab Pro is active on this computer. Thank you!

proRevoked.message: Your license is no longer valid (for example, after a refund).

confirmDeactivate.message: Deactivate SureTab Pro on this computer? You can activate it again later with your key.

driveUnavailable.message: Google Drive backup will be available very soon.

driveNotConnected.message: Not connected. The backup is saved in a “SureTab” folder in your Drive; SureTab can't see your other files.

driveReconnect.message: Google needs you to sign in again. Click “Connect Google Drive”.

driveError.message: The last backup failed ($ARG1$). SureTab will try again.

driveNoBackups.message: No backups in your Drive yet.

groupRestored.message: Group opened and moved to trash
